messages:
elaine: Heads-up — Ubuntu 22.04 base images in prod just moved to a point release that includes libssl and glibc fixes. We need a short plan: build+scan, KMS signing verification, RBAC check for signer role, and an audit-log correlation step before promotion. Who can take ownership for a canary rollout?

tucker: I can drive the canary. Proposal: 3-stage rollforward — build immutable image -> deploy to staging cluster slice -> 1% prod slice for 2h -> promote. Need to validate user-facing latency and syscalls. :thumbsup:

maria: Also add a preflight that validates package metadata and changelogs. Quick commands we can run in CI: 
```
dpkg -l | grep -E "libssl|glibc"
apt changelog libssl-dev | head -n 40
curl -sSL https://pkg-cache.example.com/sha256sums.txt | grep $(sha256sum image.tar.gz | cut -d' ' -f1)
```

jon: For signing: devops-jen, can your KMS rotation window allow signing from a short-lived key? We want to ensure the attestation includes KMS key id and signer subject. Auditors will want that info.

devops-jen: Yes, we can mint a one-off signing key via KMS with a 6h TTL and log the key-id in the attestation. Need to confirm the signer role's IAM policy — it currently allows `signImage` on `projects/*/images/*`. We should tighten to `projects/redwood-prod/images/base-*`.

security-bot: Automated alert: CVE-2026-1984 (libssl) and CVE-2026-2102 (glibc) detected in images built before 2026-02-12. Severity: High. See https://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2026-1984

elaine: Good catch. Tucker, when you do canary, please include these verification steps in the runbook: 
- package diff vs current image (list package versions)
- runtime smoke tests (replicate small seq-latency tests)
- KMS attestation verification (key-id present, signature verified)
- audit log correlation: ensure deploy entry matches image digest and signer principal

tucker: Will do. I'll create a short runbook gist and a CI job `ci/baseimage-rollforward` that: 
1) builds image -> signs -> uploads to staging registry
2) runs vuln-scan (trivy), SBOM generation, and runs `verify-signature` script
3) deploys to canary slice and sends a webhook to #eng-oncall for 2h observation

maria: One more: add an RBAC smoke-check that tries to list signer roles with a broken principal to ensure least privilege. Example script: 
```
# expect 403 if role is locked down
oc auth can-i sign-image --project redwood-prod --principal test-bot || true
```

jon: If canary passes, promotion should be automated but gated by a signed approval from two people in the `image-release` group. Record approvals in the audit log with the image digest.

devops-jen: I'll update IAM policy and add the KMS key-id to the attestation payload. Also adding an alert if a deploy uses unsigned images.

elaine: Thanks — action items: Tucker (canary + runbook), Devops-jen (KMS + IAM tighten), Maria (preflight scripts), Jon (approval gating + audit log check). I’ll file a brief doc for compliance with the steps above.

security-bot: Reminder: tag this thread with `incident-orch` if any rollbacks happen so SRE can correlate traces.

jon: Noted. If anything flaps during the 1% slice we immediately rollback and rotate the signing key for investigation.

elaine: OK closing chat here, please post the runbook link and CI job name when ready. :white_check_mark:
